title: Bounded finite free constant projection formula
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring, let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes, and work in the unbounded derived categories of module sheaves on their small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let $K\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ be arbitrary. Let $P$ be a cochain complex of $A$-modules and let $a,b\in\mathbf Z$ such that $P^i=0$ for $i<a$ and for $i>b$. Assume that for every $i$ there is $n_i\in\mathbf N$ and an isomorphism $P^i\cong A^{n_i}$. Write $P_Y$ for the derived image of $P$ under the exact constant-sheaf functor. Then the canonical projection morphism [def-kun-projection-formula-map]
$$Rf_*K\otimes_A^L P_Y\longrightarrow Rf_*(K\otimes_A^L Lf^*P_Y)$$
is an isomorphism. No boundedness assumption on $K$ and no cohomological-dimension assumption on $f$ are required.

proof.text: Each finite free term becomes a dualizable constant sheaf: transport the proved isDualizableSheaf_constantSheaf_pi along its finite-basis isomorphism. Apply the source-library theorem DerivedCategory.isDualizableEtale_Q_obj to the bounded termwise constant complex. Transport dualizability through the exact constant functor comparison mapDerivedCategoryFactors. The proved source-library theorem isIso_rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap_app_app_of_isDualizable makes the canonical projection map invertible at this derived constant complex. These source-library results are proved, so no finite-free projection assumption or new hole is used.

proof_origin.place: Proof step 2, via proved source-library finite-power dualizability, bounded-complex dualizability, and projection formula at a dualizable coefficient.

lean.statement:
theorem isIso_projectionMap_bounded_finiteFree_constant
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)))
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ℤ) (a b : ℤ)
    [P.IsStrictlyGE a] [P.IsStrictlyLE b]
    (hP : ∀ i : ℤ, ∃ n : ℕ,
      Nonempty (P.X i ≅ ModuleCat.of A (Fin n → A))) :
    IsIso (((rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).app K).app
      ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)))
